articles.summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP (NYSE:KNOP): Hedda Knutsen acquisition KNOT Offshore Partners LP (NYSE:KNOP) (“KNOP”, “we” or ”us”) announced today that its wholly owned subsidiary, KNOT Shuttle Tankers AS, has agreed to acquire Knutsen Canadian Chartering AS, the company that owns the shuttle tanker, Hedda Knutsen , from Knutsen NYK Offshore Tankers AS (the “Acquisition”). The purchase price is $113.0 million, less $89.4 million of outstanding indebtedness, plus $0.8 million of capitalized fees related to the credit facility secured by the Hedda Knutsen . The initial cost of the Acquisition will therefore be approximately $24.4 million, and is subject to customary post-closing adjustments for working capital. The Hedda Knutsen , a 154,000-deadweight ton DP2 Suezmax class shuttle tanker, was built by COSCO Shipping Heavy Industry and delivered in 2024. articles.summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP (NYSE:KNOP) ( “ the Partnership”) plans to release its financial results for the 2 nd Quarter of 2026 prior to opening of the market on Friday, September 4, 2026. The Partnership also plans to host a conference call on Friday, September 4, 2026, at 9:30 AM (Eastern Time) to discuss the results for the 2 nd Quarter of 2026. All unitholders and interested parties are invited to join via the live webcast link on the Partnership’s website: www.knotoffshorepartners.com . A replay of the webcast will be available at the same link following the conclusion of the live call. Our 2 nd Quarter 2026 Earnings Presentation will also be available at www.knotoffshorepartners.com prior to the conference call start time.
